description: Application of the proton-scale tau_hat_0 realisation (PR #533) to the mass-tower jet form. Finding: at A=1 the tower is structurally empty beyond level 0 (no triples at level 0 to source level-1 sub-braids). The proton residual ~500 ppm vs CODATA is therefore NOT a tower-truncation issue.
verdict_detail: Proton (A=1) has 1 nucleon, 0 pairs, 0 triples at level 0. By the inter-level ascension rule of pentagon-uv-commutation.md (line 56-60), level-(n+1) sub-braids are produced ONLY by triples at level n absorbing. With S_2^(0) empty, S_1^(n) is empty for all n >= 1. The mass formula at proton reduces to |tr_M(W)| + Phi_q(|tr_M(W)|) plus R_N = 0.

tau_hat_consistency_check.claim: At proton scale with universal connection, ANY lifted level-0 element has zero transient component.
tau_hat_consistency_check.computation: (1 - tau_hat_0)(ell_0(W)) = ell_0(W) - ell_0(d_1(ell_0(W))) = ell_0(W) - ell_0(W) = 0, using the splitting d_1 . ell_0 = id_{A_0} verified numerically in PR #533 (tau-hat-n-proton-realisation.witness.json).

where_phase_a3_applies.structural_threshold: A >= 3 (atoms with at least 1 triple of nucleons at level 0)
where_phase_a3_applies.interpretation: At A=3, level-1 contributions can be non-zero (one triple at level 0 absorbs to level 1). The 3000 ppm residual at T / He3 is the natural target for level-1 evaluation.

what_is_needed_for_A_geq_3: Generalise tau_hat_0 from A=1 (H_3, dim 6) to A=3 (H_9, dim 9! = 362880) — same construction, much larger linear algebra; would need to restrict to a principal sub-block.
Identify the transient creation modes at A >= 3 — explicit form of the pentagon q-factor identity on the H_9 transient block.
Choose a connection — universal vs q_0-aware Markov-derived; flagged as research-grade open in PR #531.

phase_a3_re_scoping.original_issue_522_phase_a3: Extend mass tower to higher levels — captures binding-energy correction currently absorbed into single-K averaging. ~10^6 ppb gap.
phase_a3_re_scoping.refined_phase_a3_prime: Extend tower at A >= 3 ONLY. Proton (A=1) and deuteron (A=2) have empty tower beyond level 0 by structural argument; their residuals come from level 0 (q-Hecke vs MN, Phi_q exactness, etc.).
